archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss/Authority) & 5 (Luxury) Hybrid - Premium Law School Admin

brand_identity.description: A refined admin panel comparable to Linear or Vercel but styled with a classic law-school editorial feel. Uses warm parchment backgrounds and deep legal red to establish trust and authority while keeping layouts functional, calm, and data-dense.

scales.metric_value: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-light tracking-tighter text-slate-900 dark:text-white
scales.metric_label: text-sm font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Calm, progressive disclosure. High whitespace, minimal borders. Linear/Vercel style architecture.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 fixed height, collapsible on desktop. Mobile off-canvas drawer.

components.buttons: Shadcn based. Primary buttons use Deep Legal Red background. Subtle scale-down effect on active state. Icons inside buttons.
components.cards: Flat background, subtle 1px border. Linear-style minimalism. Padding p-6.
components.tables: Searchable. Header row has subtle background. Rows highlight on hover. Checkboxes for bulk actions. Status badges (e.g., Active/Inactive) use pill shape.
components.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn Input, Select, and Textarea. Focus states must have an outer ring in primary color.
components.badges: Soft background tint + distinct dot indicator. e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-800 with a small green dot.
components.command_palette: Global search triggered by Cmd+K. Overlays with glassmorphism backdrop.
components.drawers_and_dialogs: Used for filters, quick-edits, or confirmations. Slide-in from right (drawers) or centered (dialogs).
components.blog_create_edit: Multi-step/tabs (Content, SEO, Media) to prevent vertical fatigue. Sticky save bar at top.

interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements must shift in color and/or slight translation (-translate-y-0.5 for cards).
interactions.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching exact dimensions of final content. Pulse animation.
interactions.empty_states: Minimalist icon, brief explanation text, and clear primary CTA button.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, menus, table rows, badges) MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case based on their role (e.g., 'global-search-trigger', 'create-blog-submit', 'sidebar-link-dashboard').

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize the Admin login UI, Dashboard, and Blogs (Create/Edit) module.
Implement light and dark mode toggling using standard Tailwind class strategies.
Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for premium iconography.
Apply Playfair Display exclusively to major headings (H1/H2), and use IBM Plex Sans everywhere else.
Mock data interactions entirely via UI state (no backend). Implement complex tables, command palette, and sticky save bars precisely as described.
Never use placeholders for images; use the provided media URLs.
